title: 第一卷 第24章 上门拜主
content_zh:
凤霞山庄内。

    凤无极赤怒着双眸，一手提着酒坛子，哗哗往嘴里灌着酒。

    身为凤家人，他这辈子还没这么憋屈过！

    气势汹汹的带着铁犀团离开山庄，结果不仅没有教训上杀他女人的人，还把百宝楼彻底弄没了！

    他本想着回来，召集庄子上的强者，再杀去凤州城，却又被老太君给狠狠训斥了一顿。

    “吗的，真是窝火！”

    凤无极的眼睛，赤红的吓人，仿佛想要吃人一般。

    “你，过来给老子跪下！老子现在火气很大！”

    凤无极犹如狂兽，恶狠狠的朝着身边伺候的丫鬟喝道。

    模样娇俏，看起来不过十四五岁的小丫鬟，眼眸吓得一颤，连忙扑通一声跪在地上，哽咽道：“求二爷饶了奴婢吧！”

    凤无极一脸怒然，抬手揪住丫鬟的头发，凶狠道：“你一个贱婢，能够伺候老子，是你的荣幸！今日你若不能泄了老子这一身火气，老子就把你剁碎了喂狗！”

    “呜呜呜——”

    ……

    山庄另一个院子里。

    一个身穿金袍的中年男子，脸朝屋舍方向，恭敬的立在院子里。

    “母亲，唤孩儿来有何吩咐？”凤天应恭声问道。

    “最近看着点老二，别让他犯蠢。”屋舍内传出的声音，竟是一个异常年轻的女子声音。

    而这声音的主人，正是凤霞山庄的老太君凤池华，亦是庄主凤天应和二爷凤无极的生母！

    凤天应笑道：“孩儿会盯着二弟的，不过母亲已经嘱咐过他了，想必二弟是不会乱来的。”

    “哼，他那莽性子，可是难说得很。秦家那小子有些邪性，凤家没必要为了一个贱女人和一个小小的百宝楼，再去招惹他。倘若非杀不可，也要等一个合适的时机再出手。”凤池华冷哼道。

    凤天应笑道：“孩儿也是如此作想的。这秦家小子，杀了谢镇和谢诚，灵山宗必然不会饶了他，我们先且看看，他能不能在灵山宗的手中活下来再说。”

    凤池华道：“如果他能在灵山宗的手中活下来，凤家可以先给他一个机会。”

    凤天应神色一动，讶然道：“母亲的意思是，让他加入我凤家的队伍，进入云山秘境？”

    “这小子实力不错，不用可惜了。”凤池华的声音里，含着一抹冷笑。

    凤天应笑道：“孩儿知道了。”

    “嗯，凤家有你主持大局，为娘还是很放心的。但耀然的修炼，你还是要督促着点。他有天赋在身，如果能够再努力一些，他可以变得更优秀！”
content_en:
Inside Fengxia Villa.

    Feng Wuji's eyes were filled with anger, he held the wine jar in one hand and poured wine into his mouth.

    As a member of the Feng family, he has never been so aggrieved in his life!

    He left the villa with the Iron Rhinoceros Group angrily, but not only did he fail to teach the person who killed his woman a lesson, but he also completely destroyed the Baibao Building!

    He originally wanted to come back, summon the strong men from Zhuangzi, and then kill him in Fengzhou City, but he was severely reprimanded by the old lady.

    "Oh no, I'm really angry!"

    Feng Wuji's eyes were frighteningly red, as if he wanted to eat someone.

    "You, come here and kneel down for me! I'm very angry now!"

    Like a wild beast, Feng Wuji shouted fiercely at the maid serving beside him.

    The pretty little maid who looked like she was no more than fourteen or fifteen years old, her eyes trembled with fright, and she quickly knelt on the ground with a plop, choking and saying: "Please spare me, Master!"

    Feng Wuji looked angry, raised his hand and grabbed the maid's hair, and said fiercely: "You are a cheap maid, it is your honor to serve me! If you can't vent my anger today, I will chop you into pieces and feed you to the dogs!"

    "Uuuuuu——"

    …

    In another courtyard of the villa.

    A middle-aged man wearing a golden robe, facing the direction of the house, stood respectfully in the yard.

    "Mother, what are your instructions for calling the child?" Feng Tianying asked respectfully.

    "Keep an eye on your second son lately, don't let him make mistakes." The voice coming from the house was actually the voice of an unusually young woman.

    The owner of this voice is Feng Chihua, the old lady of Fengxia Villa, and the biological mother of the owner Feng Tianying and the second master Feng Wuji!

    Feng Tianying said with a smile: "The child will stare at the second brother, but mother has already told him, so the second brother will not act randomly."

    "Hmph, it's hard to explain his reckless temper. That boy from the Qin family has some evil nature. There is no need for the Feng family to provoke him again just for a bitch and a small treasure house. If he must kill him, he should wait for a suitable time before taking action." Feng Chihua snorted coldly.

    Feng Tianying said with a smile: "The kid thinks so too. If this Qin family boy killed Xie Zhen and Xie Cheng, the Lingshan Sect will definitely not let him go. Let's see first if he can survive in the hands of the Lingshan Sect."

    Feng Chihua said: "If he can survive in the hands of Lingshan Sect, the Feng family can give him a chance first."

    Feng Tianying's expression changed, and he said in surprise: "What does mother mean, let him join my Feng family's team and enter the Yunshan secret realm?"

    "This kid is pretty good, so there's no need to feel pity." There was a sneer in Feng Chihua's voice.

    Feng Tianying smiled and said, "I know, kid."

    "Well, I feel relieved that the Feng family has you in charge of the overall situation. But you still have to supervise Yaoran's practice. He has talent. If he can work harder, he can become even better!"
